sources.entry: ccxray by lis186 - A transparent HTTP proxy and real-time dashboard that sits between Claude Code and the Anthropic API. Captures every request and response without configuration, presenting them in a Miller-column interface with session grouping, token/cost tracking, and context-window visualization.

summary.one_liner: A zero-config HTTP proxy and real-time dashboard that records every API call between Claude Code, Codex, or Grok and their upstream APIs so you can inspect agent sessions, tokens, costs, and context usage.
summary.what_it_does: Runs as a local HTTP proxy that Claude Code, Codex, or Grok CLI traffic is routed through, recording each request and response to local log files under ~/.ccxray/logs. A browser dashboard shows sessions grouped by project in a Miller-column layout, with a workflow timeline of turn cards, parallel lanes for subagents, and per-turn token and cost figures. It tracks cache warmth and TTL, estimates subscription plan from cache usage fields, and shows 5-hour and weekly rate-limit usage for Claude and Codex accounts. Additional features include a system prompt tracker with diff view, request interception with editing before forwarding, an optional context HUD appended to Claude responses, and a usage analytics CLI (ccxray usage). Summaries can optionally be exported to Google Cloud Storage via setup.
use_cases: Inspect what system prompts and tools Claude Code sends
Track token usage and cost per session or project
Debug why an agent turn is slow or using lots of context
Monitor Claude and Codex rate-limit quotas across accounts
Pause and edit API requests before they reach Anthropic
Compare multiple concurrent agent sessions in one dashboard
how_to_run: docker build -t ccxray . && docker run -p 5577:5577 ccxray
notable: Zero-config: launching via ccxray claude routes traffic through the proxy and opens the dashboard automatically
Hub sharing on macOS and Linux so multiple terminals feed one dashboard
Fail-open design: if the proxy cannot load, the agent starts directly (unless CCXRAY_FAIL_CLOSED=1)
Workflow timeline with parallel lanes for orchestrator and subagents, plus keyboard-first navigation
Request intercept and edit before forwarding to the upstream API
caveats: Codex support is Beta; ChatGPT-login sessions with certain Codex versions fail through the proxy (issue #671)
Windows has no shared hub; each launch needs its own port
Licensed PolyForm Noncommercial, so commercial use is restricted
Summary export can include user identity and repo names and is not comprehensively scrubbed
keywords: see what my coding agent is sending
